data.situation:
After moving in, Lin kept the kitchen equipment list beside the sink. When the tap began to leak, she took the photograph described in her first repair message. The cupboard was still dry after she wiped it, but she wanted to prevent further damage. A waterproof mat protected the shelf from small splashes; it did not stop the leak. She moved the cleaning bottles out of the way and sent the landlord the photograph. Lin: The kitchen window is still stuck, and the tap is leaking. Could you confirm the repair date?
Landlord: The plumber can come on Thursday morning. The window repair is booked for Friday.
Lin: Thank you. I felt stuck while I was waiting for a date, because I couldn't arrange time off work. I'll be home on Thursday. Maintenance visit
Thursday: repair the leaking tap.
Friday: repair the kitchen window.
Next month: insulate the exposed pipe in the storeroom before winter.
Regular checks help maintain the shared building. Please report new faults. After the plumber replaced the worn washer, Lin ran the tap and checked the cupboard. The dripping had stopped. She put the mat back, then wrote a short note for Maya: fixing a leak is one way to reduce water consumption at home. Their next bill would show the amount used; neither of them treated a hope of lower use as a measured saving.

readingBlocks.en: After moving in, Lin kept the kitchen equipment list beside the sink. When the tap began to leak, she took the photograph described in her first repair message. The cupboard was still dry after she wiped it, but she wanted to prevent further damage. A waterproof mat protected the shelf from small splashes; it did not stop the leak. She moved the cleaning bottles out of the way and sent the landlord the photograph.
readingBlocks.zh: 搬入后，林把厨房设备单放在水槽边。水龙头开始漏水时，她拍下了第一条报修消息中提到的照片。擦拭后的橱柜还干着，但她想防止继续损坏。一张防水垫保护搁板免受小水花影响；它并不能止漏。她把清洁用品挪开，将照片发给房东。

readingBlocks.en:
Lin: The kitchen window is still stuck, and the tap is leaking. Could you confirm the repair date?
Landlord: The plumber can come on Thursday morning. The window repair is booked for Friday.
Lin: Thank you. I felt stuck while I was waiting for a date, because I couldn't arrange time off work. I'll be home on Thursday.
readingBlocks.zh:
林：厨房窗户仍卡着，水龙头也在漏水。可以确认维修日期吗？
房东：水管工周四上午可以来。窗户维修安排在周五。
林：谢谢。等维修日期时我觉得事情卡住了，因为没法安排请假。我周四会在家。

readingBlocks.en:
Maintenance visit
Thursday: repair the leaking tap.
Friday: repair the kitchen window.
Next month: insulate the exposed pipe in the storeroom before winter.
Regular checks help maintain the shared building. Please report new faults.
readingBlocks.zh:
维护上门安排
周四：维修漏水的水龙头。
周五：维修厨房窗户。
下个月：入冬前为储藏室外露水管加保温层。
定期检查有助于维护共用楼房。发现新的故障，请告知。
readingBlocks.title: Maintenance visit

readingBlocks.en: After the plumber replaced the worn washer, Lin ran the tap and checked the cupboard. The dripping had stopped. She put the mat back, then wrote a short note for Maya: fixing a leak is one way to reduce water consumption at home. Their next bill would show the amount used; neither of them treated a hope of lower use as a measured saving.
readingBlocks.zh: 水管工换掉磨损的垫圈后，林打开水龙头，检查橱柜。滴水已经停止。她把防水垫放回去，给玛雅写了张短便条：修好漏水，是降低家庭用水量的一种办法。下一张账单才会写出实际用量；她们没有把希望少用水当成已测量的节省。
